title: Jewel Toned Australian Onion Frittata
description: A creamy and earthy Australian dish featuring caramelized onions and a hint of sweetness, perfect for a brunch mood. This macrobiotic-friendly frittata is made with wholesome ingredients and a touch of glaze.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until caramelized.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked onions and garlic in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the top with balsamic glaze.
Let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
